summaries.summary: Protests in Delhi have resulted in the detention of multiple leaders, including former Chief Ministers Mamata Banerjee and Pinarayi Vijayan, amid claims of arbitrary police actions and mass detentions by authorities.

Apple is expected to unveil new smart home devices at its upcoming event, including products developed in collaboration with LG. Additionally, Cloudflare has acquired Deno to enhance its Workers programming model.
Research on psychedelic effects reveals alterations in brain activity, indicating potential therapeutic benefits.
A Flydubai co-pilot plotted a terrorist attack in Israel, drawing parallels to the 9/11 attacks, heightening security concerns in aviation.
A court has convicted former AAP councillor Tahir Hussain for his role in the 2020 Delhi riots, which raises discussions around accountability in communal violence.
